title: Contrix Read Receipt
description: Public/shared read receipt for Flow timeline UI hint. NOT canonical truth, NOT a multi-device cursor (see read-marker.schema.json for that). MUST NOT generate push notifications. Privacy is governed by Realm policy: Realms MAY allow public, members-only, or actor-private receipt sharing.

flow_id.description: Required when receipt scopes to a Flow timeline (the common case). Omitted only for whole-Realm receipt forms when explicitly allowed by Realm policy.

track.description: Active track on the target Flow. Defaults to 'discussion' when omitted. Threads / synthesis tracks MUST set explicitly.

actor_id.description: DID of the reader. Aligned with the rest of the spec; older drafts used 'reader' / 'actor'.

event_id.description: ID of the most recent Event the actor has read. Causality implies all causal predecessors are also read.

hlc.description: Optional. HLC of the read position; required when Sync Service must compare receipts under merge / debounce rules across devices for the same actor.
